pairs.subject: translation-quality-measurement
pairs.evidence: docs/i18n/glossary.md:1 The repo keeps a termbase (glossary.md plus a per-locale '## Termbase' in each style guide), but no script, hook or CI job checks the 13 machine-translated locale catalogs against it (no 'glossary'/'termbase' reference in scripts/, lefthook.yml, package.json or .github/workflows), so the strongest deterministic signal the subject names is missing, while skeleton parity is properly gated by check-untranslated --strict.

techniques.evidence: docs/i18n/glossary.md:1 Skeleton parity is realized well: scripts/i18n/lib/untranslated.mjs:112 brokenPlaceholderKeys compares brace spans in any script, one direction only, and fails pre-commit. But nothing checks termbase adherence or duplicate-source divergence (no rule found in scripts/i18n), so two of the four decidable classes are not run.
scripts/i18n/translate-extract.mjs:14 One engine is used for all 13 pairs (ar..zh), set by convention with 'medium quality is fine'. No per-pair measurement or recorded per-pair choice was found.

docs/i18n/source-defects.md:3 Source-ambiguity findings go to the source owner and are never worked around inside a locale. Each row names the missing input and the locales that reported it, so this is the cross-language-agreement form rather than two-model divergence.
